title: Advanced Python for Backend Engineers
description: Learn the Python language tools that make backend code lazy, composable, concurrent, and easier to reason about.
learningOutcomes: Use decorators, iterators, generators, and value objects without hiding control flow
Run related async work with clear cancellation and cleanup behavior
Choose correctly between async I/O, threads, and processes
Use synchronization and context-local state safely in backend applications

lessons.title: Closures, Decorators, and Callable Objects
lessons.description: Wrap behavior while preserving readable contracts.

lessons.title: Iterators, Generators, and Streaming
lessons.description: Process data lazily and control resource lifetime.

lessons.title: Dataclasses, Enums, and Value Objects
lessons.description: Represent backend concepts with small explicit types.

lessons.title: asyncio Task Groups and Cancellation
lessons.description: Structure concurrent I/O and clean it up correctly.

lessons.title: Threads, the GIL, and Processes
lessons.description: Match execution models to blocking and CPU-bound work.

lessons.title: Synchronization, Queues, and Context Variables
lessons.description: Coordinate work without leaking request state.

lessons.title: Memory, Profiling, and Python Performance
lessons.description: Find real Python bottlenecks before optimizing.

assignment.title: Assignment: Concurrent Export Pipeline
assignment.description: Build a bounded streaming export with decorators, async fetching, context propagation, and measured behavior.
